result.instructions: Tools for SIGNL4, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which alerts are still open and unacknowledged right now?"; "Who is on duty in our team right now and who is off?"; "How many alerts did each team get over the last weeks?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SIGNL4 data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run signl4_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run signl4_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run signl4_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. signl4_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: signl4_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List the SIGNL4 teams the API key can access: id, name, description, time zone and member ids. Team ids are needed to raise alerts and to look up categories and duties. GET /v3/teams.

team_ids.description: Limit to these team ids (default: all teams the key can access).

items.description: SIGNL4 team id (a GUID); get it from signl4_list_teams.

tools.name: signl4_get_team
tools.title: Get team
tools.description: One SIGNL4 team: name, description, time zone, member ids. GET /v3/teams/{teamId}.

team_id.description: SIGNL4 team id (a GUID); get it from signl4_list_teams.

tools.name: signl4_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the SIGNL4 users the key can access with name, e-mail, contact addresses, activation state and duty status per team (dutyMode, onDutyTime). User ids are needed to acknowledge/close/annotate alerts. GET /v3/users.

tools.name: signl4_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: One SIGNL4 user: name, e-mail, contact addresses, time zone and duty status per team. GET /v3/users/{userId}.

user_id.description: SIGNL4 user id (a GUID); get it from signl4_list_users.

tools.name: signl4_list_team_users
tools.title: List users of teams
tools.description: List the users of the given teams (all accessible teams by default) with duty status. Teams that cannot be read are reported under `errors`. GET /v3/teams/users.

team_ids.description: Limit to these team ids (default: all teams the key can access).

items.description: SIGNL4 team id (a GUID); get it from signl4_list_teams.

tools.name: signl4_list_categories
tools.title: List alert categories
tools.description: List the alert categories of a team (name, color, keywords used to auto-classify alerts). The category name can be passed to signl4_raise_alert. GET /v3/categories/{teamId}.

team_id.description: SIGNL4 team id (a GUID); get it from signl4_list_teams.

tools.name: signl4_list_alerts
tools.title: List alerts
tools.description: Search SIGNL4 alerts (signls), newest first, with status, severity, category and history (created, acknowledged, closed). Filter by team, status, creation time, text or external id. Up to 100 per page; pass the returned continuation_token to get the next page. POST /v3/signls/paged (a read).

team_ids.description: Limit to these team ids (default: all teams the key can access).

items.description: SIGNL4 team id (a GUID); get it from signl4_list_teams.

status.description: Only alerts in this state (default: all).

created_after.description: ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

created_before.description: ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

text.description: Free-text search in title and text.

external_id.description: Only alerts raised with this external id.

category_ids.description: Only alerts of these category ids (see signl4_list_categories).

continuation_token.description: The continuation_token of the previous page.

tools.name: signl4_get_alert
tools.title: Get alert
tools.description: Full detail of one alert: title, text, severity, category, status and delivery status, history (who acknowledged/closed it and when), parameters, attachments and escalations with per-user delivery. GET /v3/signls/{signlId}/details.

alert_id.description: Alert (signl) id; get it from signl4_list_alerts or the id returned by signl4_raise_alert.

tools.name: signl4_get_alert_timeline
tools.title: Get alert timeline
tools.description: The ordered timeline of an alert: creation, notifications, acknowledgements, annotations, escalations and remote actions. GET /v3/signls/{signlId}/timeline.

alert_id.description: Alert (signl) id; get it from signl4_list_alerts or the id returned by signl4_raise_alert.

tools.name: signl4_get_alert_report
tools.title: Get alert report
tools.description: Alert volume and response statistics per team over several time periods: acknowledged, closed and unhandled counts, overall and per category (optionally for one user). Teams that cannot be read are reported under `errors`. GET /v3/signls/report.

team_ids.description: Limit to these team ids (default: all teams the key can access).

items.description: SIGNL4 team id (a GUID); get it from signl4_list_teams.

tools.name: signl4_raise_alert
tools.title: Raise alert
tools.description: WRITE: raise a new alert in a SIGNL4 team. THIS NOTIFIES REAL PEOPLE: every team member currently on duty is paged (push, SMS and/or voice call according to their settings) and the alert escalates if nobody acknowledges it. Only use it when the user clearly asked to alert the team; never for tests unless they said so. Not idempotent: a second call pages the team again. Returns the new alert incl. its id. POST /v3/signls.

team_id.description: SIGNL4 team id (a GUID); get it from signl4_list_teams.

title.description: Alert title, shown on the pager screen.

severity.description: Severity (default: SIGNL4's default for the team).

external_id.description: Your own reference for this alert, for later look-up (and for SIGNL4 to group follow-ups).

tools.name: signl4_acknowledge_alert
tools.title: Acknowledge alert
tools.description: WRITE: acknowledge an alert on behalf of a SIGNL4 user (recorded in its history under that user). Stops escalation to further tiers for that alert. POST /v3/signls/{signlId}/acknowledge.

alert_id.description: Alert (signl) id; get it from signl4_list_alerts or the id returned by signl4_raise_alert.

user_id.description: The SIGNL4 user the acknowledgement is recorded for; see signl4_list_users.

comment.description: Optional comment stored with the acknowledgement.

tools.name: signl4_close_alert
tools.title: Close alert
tools.description: WRITE: close (resolve) an alert on behalf of a SIGNL4 user; it leaves the open list and stops all further notifications. POST /v3/signls/{signlId}/close.

alert_id.description: Alert (signl) id; get it from signl4_list_alerts or the id returned by signl4_raise_alert.

user_id.description: The SIGNL4 user the closure is recorded for; see signl4_list_users.

comment.description: Optional comment stored with the closure.

tools.name: signl4_annotate_alert
tools.title: Annotate alert
tools.description: WRITE: add a text note to an alert's timeline on behalf of a SIGNL4 user. The note is visible to the team in the app. It does not page anyone by itself. POST /v3/signls/{signlId}/annotate.

alert_id.description: Alert (signl) id; get it from signl4_list_alerts or the id returned by signl4_raise_alert.

user_id.description: The SIGNL4 user the note is recorded for; see signl4_list_users.

tools.name: signl4_list_duty_schedules
tools.title: List duty schedules
tools.description: Planned on-call duty schedules (who is on duty when): start/end, team, user, tier, stand-in and shift info. Filter by team, user and time window. POST /v3/schedules (a read).

team_ids.description: Limit to these team ids (default: all teams the key can access).

items.description: SIGNL4 team id (a GUID); get it from signl4_list_teams.

from.description: Start of the window, ISO 8601 with timezone.

to.description: End of the window, ISO 8601 with timezone.

tools.name: signl4_get_duty_status
tools.title: Get user duty status
tools.description: Whether a user is currently on or off duty in each of their teams (dutyMode, onDutyTime, tier). GET /v3/users/{userId}/dutyStatus.

user_id.description: SIGNL4 user id (a GUID); get it from signl4_list_users.

team_ids.description: Limit to these team ids (default: all teams the key can access).

items.description: SIGNL4 team id (a GUID); get it from signl4_list_teams.

tools.name: signl4_get_duty_summary
tools.title: Get duty summary
tools.description: Duty assistant info per team: whether it is enabled and the last two (or all) duty periods. GET /v3/duties/summary.

team_ids.description: Limit to these team ids (default: all teams the key can access).

items.description: SIGNL4 team id (a GUID); get it from signl4_list_teams.

last_two_only.description: Only the last two duties (default true).

tools.name: signl4_list_audit_logs
tools.title: List audit logs
tools.description: Audit log of changes and events in the SIGNL4 subscription (who changed what, when). Filter by team, time window and message text; pass the returned continuation_token for the next page. GET /v3/audits.

team_ids.description: Limit to these team ids (default: all teams the key can access).

items.description: SIGNL4 team id (a GUID); get it from signl4_list_teams.

from.description: ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

to.description: ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

message_contains.description: Only entries whose message contains this text.

continuation_token.description: The continuation_token of the previous page.
